references.title: A. Blokhuis, A. E. Brouwer, B. M. M. de Weger, Binomial collisions and near collisions, Integers 17 (2017) #A64
references.note: Theorem 2.2: no unknown collisions of the shape (m,l) = (n−2, k+1); none is known of this shape, so there are none.

references.title: R. J. Stroeker, B. M. M. de Weger, Elliptic binomial Diophantine equations, Acta Arith. 87 (1999) 339–365
references.note: Cited through the proof of BBdW Theorem 2.2 for the shapes (m,l) = (n−1,k+2) and (n−2,k+1); the paper itself was not opened today.

summary: Known: the equation C(n,k) = C(n−2,k+1) has no solutions in the half-triangle ranges (Stroeker and de Weger 1999, by elliptic-curve methods; collected as a case of Theorem 2.2 of Blokhuis, Brouwer and de Weger 2017). Not formalised.
